mentions.name: Marginalia Search
mentions.description: An ongoing web search engine project. Current work includes integrating website liveness data into the crawler to make informed decisions about keeping or wiping data from unreachable sites, making website URL elements searchable, and deploying a voluntary max-charge request header for its commercial API.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm always working on the same old project Marginalia Search and I have been for going on five years now.
